verdict.rationale: Modal's primary interface is the Python SDK/CLI, which programmatically covers most sandbox lifecycle actions (create, run commands, filesystem access, snapshots, networking, attach/manage containers) per modal-docs-8/9/10/13/15/18. However, the JS/Go SDKs are explicitly limited ('interact with some Modal platform resources' — modal-gh-1), and no public OpenAPI/REST spec was found (modal-probe-3 shows 404s across all candidate endpoints), so parity between the web dashboard (used for logging/visibility, modal-docs-6) and programmatic access isn't fully documented. Missing for 10: confirmed full API parity across all SDKs (not just Python), an official public API spec, and explicit documentation that every dashboard/UI action has an API equivalent.
